notes.title: Star Trek Prodigy: Supernova Leaving Stores In September
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p] [/p][p]We wanted to inform you that Star Trek Prodigy: Supernova is soon to be leaving the Steam store at the end of September, as our licensing agreement for the title has concluded.[/p][p] [/p][p]If you already own the game, there’s no need to worry - it will remain in your library and will continue to be fully playable.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for your continued support![/p]

notes.content:
Cadets, it's time to boldly go to the Caves of the Forgotten and rescue our fellow crewmate, Jankom Pog.

On this arduous journey, we will cross over the dry riverbed, and discover how the Watchers followed orders from the Diviner and invaded and then enslaved a colony in their own homeland. 🚀☄️🎮

notes.title: OG Walkthrough - Star Trek Prodigy: Supernova | Episode 1
notes.content:
Listen up Cadets! 

Orisi was a planet once full of natural resources, now dried of its original beauty because of the Dyson Sphere. The planet’s inhabitants paid the price, and now Watchers have settled there, hoarding all the power. But don’t let them stop you. 

Choose from Dal’s ranged attacks 🔫 or Gwyn's melee attacks ⚔️ to destroy them. Complete the puzzles, collect the Punnies and find the missing pieces from the Protostar 🚀. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zmd2O3s6FRs

#StarTrekProdigy #StarTrekProdigySupernova
